blocks.text: Hunger and health are separate stored nutrients, not FE. Matching modules collect them, processors transfer or produce them, and restoration uses the player’s current need and the module’s available contents.

rows: Hunger nutrient; matching piping/logs reach a Hunger Processor.
Health nutrient; matching piping/logs reach a Health Processor.
Can accept food nutrition and matching module contents.
Uses its recipe-defined health sources and matching module contents.
Carries both nutrient types and can restore automatically while carried/installed.

blocks.text: Nutrition-network traversal is bounded and checks loaded chunks. The shipped visit limit is 512 positions; this is a safety boundary, not a chunk loader. A disconnected tree or denied leaf harvest can stop collection without changing the processor inventory.
